title: Mirabel and the Oath
author: Lior Iversen
blurb: Dominic Delacroix, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
